action-walnut.purpose: Default action colour (Sesame + Walnut, light theme).

on-action-cream.purpose: Label colour on the default action.

body-sesame.purpose: Default finish body; fills the coach card.

on-body-roast.purpose: Ink on the Sesame coach card; the coach button fill.

body-cherry.purpose: Cherry Red + Walnut finish body and action (light).

body-marine.purpose: Marine Blue + Walnut finish body and action (light).

body-woodland.purpose: Woodland + Walnut finish body and action (light).

body-chocolate.purpose: Malted Chocolate + Maple finish body and action (light).

body-black.purpose: Black finish body and action (light); dark uses an off-white action.

ground-sesame.purpose: Near-neutral light ground used only for Sesame.

ground-counter.purpose: Light base ground; other finishes cast 7% of the body into it.

ground-dark.purpose: Dark base ground; finishes cast 11% of the body into it.

crema-balanced.purpose: Balanced taste; also the brand mark crema.

chart-pressure.role: Profile-chart pressure line, area and label; ignores the finish

display.purpose: The coach card barista instruction only.

label.purpose: Field, nav-group, stat and table labels; sentence case.

figure.purpose: Stat values; numbers only, units in Figtree.

figure-sm.purpose: Dial-in times, table numbers, deltas, inputs.

wordmark.purpose: Lowercase "mousetail" drawn as an SVG script, not set in a font; its l sweeps into a tail ending in a Crema orange drop.

landing-hero.purpose: The public landing's h1 only; opsz 96.

derived.purpose: Active nav pill, highlighted tag fill.

derived.name: --action-line
derived.purpose: Tag ring, list-item hover border, text selection.

derived.name: --on-body-line

legacyAliases.note: Compatibility only. The landing and charts no longer read any alias; the only remaining reads are the .banner rules in app.css (--banner-*). Do not add new reads.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Resting cards, stats, list items in light. none in dark (border instead).

shadows.name: shadow-bar
shadows.purpose: Phone tab bar upward lift (token --shadow-bar; dark uses rgba(0,0,0,0.6)).

shadows.name: shadow-chip
shadows.purpose: Selected segment of a segmented control (token --shadow-chip; none in dark).

motion.name: ease-out-quint (--spring)
motion.purpose: Press settle (0.22s), list-item and picker transforms, tab-log disc. No overshoot.

motion.name: ease-out-expo (--ease-out)
motion.purpose: Entrances: modal 0.28s, popover 0.22s, sheet 0.32s, scrim fade 0.18-0.2s, glass pour 0.9s.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Tamp-feel button press; list items scale(0.985); removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: pour
motion.value: scaleY(0.15) to none, 0.9s ease-out-expo, origin bottom
motion.purpose: Coach glass fills once per new shot.

motion.name: pull
motion.value: 140ms per machine second (35s shot in ~5s), linear rAF after a 650ms beat (150ms on replay)
motion.purpose: Landing hero: curve draws behind a playhead while the readout glass fills to 36 g; reduced motion paints the finished state.

breakpoints.name: phone-shell
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar becomes top bar + bottom tab bar.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Tighter padding, single-column grids, tables as blocks, 16px inputs.

narrative.overview:
Mousetail is a warm, friendly consumer app for the espresso bench: soft cards on a lightly wood-cast ground, plain barista language, and one bright colour that means "press me". That colour is the body of the owner's ES1. Pick a finish (Sesame, Cherry Red, Marine Blue, Woodland, Malted Chocolate, Black) and the action colour, the one filled surface, and a faint cast in the page ground all follow it. Everything else (ink, status hues, the shot glass) stays put.

The signature is the shot glass. Every shot is drawn as a demitasse on one fixed 48 g scale, so glasses compare honestly side by side, and the crema band's colour is how the shot tasted: pale for sour, hazel for balanced, dark for bitter. The glass recurs in the coach card, the dial-in strip, recent-shot rows, empty states and the brand mark.

Density is calm and generous: 20px card radii, pill buttons, 15px body, one instruction per screen set large in Fraunces. Light and dark are both first-class; light is the base. A first visit with no saved choice opens in light, on the landing and in the app alike; "Auto" follows the OS only once someone picks it. This world replaces the retired brown-on-brown "Bench Logbook". Colourway names describe the machine only; Mousetail carries no Fellow marks or UI.
keyCharacteristics: The selected finish's body colour is the action colour and fills exactly one surface (the coach card).
The ground takes a faint cast of the machine; cards sit on it with soft offset shadows (light) or a hairline border (dark).
Fraunces headings, Figtree UI, Red Hat Mono for figures only.
Every shot is a demitasse: height is yield on a fixed scale, crema colour is taste.
Tamp-feel press on every button: a small give and settle, never a bounce.

rules.name: The House Finish Rule
rules.body: Crema orange is the default and is listed first in the picker, set apart from the machine colourways by a divider. Orange text on light grounds fails contrast, so links in Crema light use link-burnt; orange stays on fills, icons and indicators.

rules.name: The Matches Your Machine Rule
rules.body: The action colour is the finish's body, adjusted only where contrast forces it. A new finish is four values per theme (`--body`, `--on-body`, `--action`, `--on-action`); every tint derives from them. Never hand-pick a tint.

rules.name: The One Machine Surface Rule
rules.body: Only the coach card is filled with `--body`. Everything else is neutral surface; the action colour appears on presses and small indicators, not as panels.

rules.name: The Fixed Coffee Rule
rules.body: Status hues, the crema scale, the liquid and the brew stages never follow the finish. Taste and health must read the same on every machine.

rules.name: The Off-White Exception Rule
rules.body: Where the action resolves to off-white or pale sesame on a dark ground (Black dark, Sesame dark), small indicators that would use the action colour (links, active nav and tab icons, latest-shot marker) use `--text` instead.

rules.name: The Figures-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Red Hat Mono sets numbers and only numbers. Units and words beside a figure ("g", "s", "Leaning sour") are Figtree. A signed delta is a mono figure (with a true minus, `−`) followed by its unit in prose.

rules.name: The Optical Size Rule
rules.body: Every Fraunces use sets `font-variation-settings: 'opsz'` to match its size (14, 24, 48, 72, and 96 for the landing hero). Do not let headings default to one optical size.

rules.name: The Barista Voice Rule
rules.body: Headlines are instructions you could say across the counter: "Grind 2 steps finer", "Let it run to 1:2.4", "Keep this grind". Confidence is said in words ("Fairly sure"), never as a percentage.

rules.name: The One Press Rule
rules.body: One primary press per viewport. The header's "Log a shot" button disappears when the coach card is showing (the coach carries the press), and on phones the header button is hidden entirely because the tab bar carries Log shot.

rules.name: The Soft-Light, Lined-Dark Rule
rules.body: Light cards carry the card shadow and a transparent border; dark cards carry no shadow and a visible `--border`. Never ship a shadowed card in dark or a bordered one in light.

rules.name: The No Hard Offset Rule
rules.body: Shadows are diffuse and negatively spread. No solid, zero-blur offset shadows.

dos: Do derive every action tint from `--action` with `color-mix(in oklab, ...)`; a new finish adds only `--body`, `--on-body`, `--action`, `--on-action` per theme.
Do keep the coach card the only `--body`-filled surface, and invert its primary button to on-body / body.
Do draw every shot as the shared Shot Glass on the fixed 48 g scale, with crema colour from the taste.
Do set figures in Red Hat Mono with tabular numerals and their units and words in Figtree.
Do give every button the tamp-feel press (`scale(0.95) translateY(1px)`, ease-out-quint) and remove it under reduced motion.
Do keep one primary press per viewport: hide the header Log button when the coach shows, and let the tab bar carry Log shot on phones.
Do use soft card shadows in light and a hairline border in dark.
Do use drawn Lucide line icons at 17 to 22px.
Do write headlines as barista instructions and confidence in words.
Do draw pressure eased through the shared smootherstep easer (never overshooting a stage) and keep the flow ceiling a step.
donts: Don't tie status hues, the crema scale, the espresso liquid or brew-stage colours to the finish.
Don't use a pale or off-white action colour for small indicators on dark grounds; use `--text` there (Black dark, Sesame dark).
Don't cast the Sesame light ground with the body; it stays `ground-sesame`.
Don't add bounce or overshoot to press or entrance motion.
Don't put units or words in mono, or set headings without a matching optical size.
Don't use Fellow logos, marks or UI; finish names describe the colourway only.
Don't add new reads of the legacy aliases (`--crema`, `--espresso`, `--on-accent`, `--tint-accent-*`, `--banner-*`).
Don't return to the retired brown-on-brown palette with a single amber accent.
